spec.title: Kamiwaza · Data Infrastructure
spec.description: Are the stores that hold platform state healthy and far from their limits?

spec.title: Coordination store space
spec.description: Largest member database as a share of its backend quota

spec.title: Database connections
spec.description: Connections as a share of max_connections

spec.title: Database cache hits
spec.description: Buffer cache hits as a share of block reads; low values mean disk reads

spec.title: Catalog heap
spec.description: Metadata catalog API heap as a share of its maximum

spec.title: Proposals
spec.description: Raft proposals committed and failed per second

spec.title: Leader changes
spec.description: Leader elections per hour; frequent elections mean unstable members or disks

spec.title: WAL fsync p99
spec.description: Write-ahead log fsync latency per member; above 10 ms slows every write

spec.title: Transactions
spec.description: Commits per second, compared with the day before

spec.title: Rollbacks and deadlocks
spec.description: Rolled-back transactions and deadlocks per second

spec.title: Connections by state
spec.description: Idle-in-transaction connections hold locks and are worth investigating

spec.title: Heap used
spec.description: Heap in use against its maximum per catalog service

spec.title: Garbage collection
spec.description: Share of wall time spent in GC; sustained values above 10% slow the catalog

spec.title: Coordination store and database errors
spec.description: etcd and PostgreSQL lines at warning level or above

options.content:
**Are the stores that hold platform state healthy and far from their limits?**

The top row is each store's health and saturation. Each section below follows the same order: traffic, errors, latency, then capacity.

- **Coordination store** is etcd.
- **Database** is the application's PostgreSQL.
- **Metadata catalog** is the catalog's JVM.
